component.name: PodFlow
component.summary: Listen to podcasts with charts from Brazil
Ouça podcasts com rankings do Brasil

description.p: PodFlow is a native GNOME podcast player with the curation of Brazil's top charts and new releases, designed with GTK 4 and Libadwaita.
O PodFlow é um app de podcasts nativo para o GNOME, com a curadoria dos rankings e das novidades do Brasil, feito com GTK 4 e Libadwaita.

ul.li: Top Podcasts and Top Episodes charts with category filters
Rankings Top Podcasts e Top Episódios com filtro por categoria
Explore page with featured shows and genre shelves
Página Explorar com destaques e prateleiras por gênero
Up Next queue, continue listening and per-episode progress
Fila A Seguir, Continuar Ouvindo e progresso de cada episódio
Optional sync of shows and progress with gpodder.net or Nextcloud
Sincronização opcional de programas e progresso com gpodder.net ou Nextcloud
Playback speed from 0.5× to 2.5× without changing the pitch
Velocidade de 0,5× a 2,5× sem alterar o tom da voz
Sleep timer, offline downloads and listening history
Timer de sono, downloads offline e histórico
GNOME Shell media controls and multimedia keys (MPRIS)
Controles de mídia do GNOME Shell e teclas multimídia (MPRIS)
Works offline with a pre-installed catalog of Brazilian podcasts
Funciona offline com um catálogo pré-instalado de podcasts brasileiros

description.p: No ads and no tracking. PodFlow is not affiliated with Apple Inc.
Sem anúncios e sem rastreamento. O PodFlow não é afiliado à Apple Inc.

description.p: Accounts and sync, a new look and a snap for the Ubuntu App Center.

ul.li: Sync followed shows and episode progress with gpodder.net, Nextcloud or any gPodder-compatible server
New purple app icon and accent color (the system accent can be used instead)
Passwords are kept in the system keyring
Snap package and a project website
